title: Title 29 - Crimes
heading: Aggravated murder
body: No person shall purposely, and with prior calculation and design, cause the death of another or the unlawful termination of another's pregnancy.

title: Title 29 - Crimes
heading: Murder
body: No person shall purposely cause the death of another or the unlawful termination of another's pregnancy.

title: Title 29 - Crimes
heading: Kidnapping
body: No person, by force, threat, or deception, shall remove another from the place where the other person is found or restrain the liberty of the other person for specified criminal purposes.

title: Title 29 - Crimes
heading: Aggravated robbery
body: No person, in attempting or committing a theft offense, shall have a deadly weapon and either display, brandish, indicate possession of, or use it.

title: Title 29 - Crimes
heading: Robbery
body: No person, in attempting or committing a theft offense, shall inflict, attempt to inflict, or threaten to inflict physical harm on another.

title: Title 29 - Crimes
heading: Burglary
body: No person, by force, stealth, or deception, shall trespass in an occupied structure with purpose to commit any criminal offense.

title: Title 29 - Crimes
heading: Theft
body: No person, with purpose to deprive the owner of property or services, shall knowingly obtain or exert control over the property or services without consent or beyond scope of consent.

title: Title 29 - Crimes
heading: Forging identification cards
body: No person shall forge or knowingly create any false identification card with purpose to defraud or facilitate a violation of law.

title: Title 29 - Crimes
heading: Disorderly conduct
body: No person shall recklessly cause inconvenience, annoyance, or alarm by engaging in fighting, threatening harm, or making unreasonable noise.

title: Title 29 - Crimes
heading: Disturbing a lawful meeting
body: No person shall purposely prevent or disturb a lawful meeting by physical action, making unreasonable noise, or disrupting proceedings.

title: Title 29 - Crimes
heading: Obstructing official business
body: No person, without privilege to do so and with purpose to prevent, obstruct, or delay the performance of a public official's lawful duties, shall do any act that hampers the performance of lawful duties.

title: Title 29 - Crimes
heading: Resisting arrest
body: No person, recklessly or by force, shall resist or interfere with a lawful arrest of the person or another.

title: Title 29 - Crimes
heading: Escape
body: No person, knowing the person is under detention or being reckless in that regard, shall purposely break or attempt to break the detention.

title: Title 29 - Crimes
heading: Carrying concealed weapons
body: No person shall knowingly carry or have, concealed on the person's person or ready at hand, any deadly weapon or dangerous ordnance unless authorized by law.

title: Title 29 - Crimes
heading: Improperly handling firearms in a motor vehicle
body: No person shall knowingly transport or have a loaded firearm in a motor vehicle in such a manner that the firearm is accessible without leaving the vehicle unless permitted by law.

title: Title 45 - Motor Vehicles
heading: Driving under suspension
body: No person whose driver's or commercial driver's license or permit has been suspended shall operate any motor vehicle upon the public roads or highways.

title: Title 45 - Motor Vehicles
heading: Obedience to traffic control devices
body: No person shall fail or refuse to comply with any lawful order or direction of a police officer or traffic control device.

title: Title 45 - Motor Vehicles
heading: Operating vehicle under the influence
body: No person shall operate any vehicle if the person is under the influence of alcohol, a drug of abuse, or a combination of them.

title: Title 45 - Motor Vehicles
heading: Speed limits
body: No person shall operate a motor vehicle at a speed greater or less than is reasonable or proper, having due regard for traffic, surface, and width of the street or highway.

title: Title 45 - Motor Vehicles
heading: Safety equipment requirements
body: No person shall operate a motor vehicle or trailer unless it is equipped with the lighting and safety equipment required by the Ohio Revised Code.
